lines.zh: 我沿着桦木树干往上爬。
lines.en: I climb up the birch trunk.

lines.zh: 树皮很滑，我的爪子抓得牢。
lines.en: The bark is smooth, but my claws hold.
I leap from this branch to that one.

lines.zh: 我在树叶间探出小脑袋。
lines.en: I poke my small head through the leaves.
The birch forest is my home.

lines.zh: 我爬得慢，但从不掉下去。
lines.en: I climb slowly, but I never fall.
Bits of bark fall on my back.
I make one turn around the trunk.
Every tree is worth a sniff.
My tail reaches ahead to test the way.
I walk along a single leaf.
The branch is high, and the wind is strong.
A butterfly on the branch. Not chasing it yet.

lines.zh: 甜浆果的味道，我滑过去。
lines.en: Smelling sweet berries, I glide over.
Patrolling the treetops counts as a walk.
You take one step; I glide two trees.
Grass prickles. I'll endure it.
I spread my gliding flaps and follow.
One glide and I'm on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 这条树梢路，我滑过百遍。
lines.en: I've glided this treetop path a hundred times.

lines.zh: 爪缝进了树皮，回头再剔。
lines.en: Bark is stuck in my claws. I'll clean it later.

lines.zh: 我滑翔时，翼膜张得最开。
lines.en: My gliding membrane spreads widest in flight.
Wings are rustling beyond the treetops.
One glide saves half the walk.
I smell sweet berries.

lines.zh: 我把自己团成一个毛球。
lines.en: I curl myself into a ball of fur.
I doze in the fork of a tree.
One ear twitches; it is only wind.
I wash my face with my paws.
Birch leaves rustle above my head.
I hug my tail for warmth.
There is no other sound in the wood.
I stick out my tongue and lick my nose.

lines.zh: 阳光透过叶子照在我背上。
lines.en: Sunlight falls through the leaves onto my back.
Sleepiness rises, and my eyes narrow.
I stare into the distance for a long time.
A bird flies past, and I stay still.

lines.zh: 我在等天黑，那时我才精神。
lines.en: I wait for nightfall, when I wake up.
There are things I have hidden in the hollow.
I scratch behind my ear with a hind paw.

lines.zh: 树汁的味道从树皮里渗出来。
lines.en: Sap seeps out through the bark.

lines.zh: 我把滑翔膜收好，盖住肚子。
lines.en: I fold my gliding flaps over my belly.

lines.zh: 有片叶子落在我头上，我懒得拨。
lines.en: A leaf lands on my head. I can't be bothered.
This blade of grass is very straight.
Pollen is drifting through the branches.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵转过去听远处。
lines.en: My ears turn toward the distance.

lines.zh: 我耳朵竖着，其实在打盹。
lines.en: My ears are up, but I'm napping.
Which tree should I glide to now?
I'm counting leaves. Seventeen so far.
My tail moved on its own. Weird.

lines.zh: 挂在枝上闲着，也是本事。
lines.en: Hanging idle on a branch is a skill too.
Membrane over me, I'm napping.
Did I forget where I hid the berries?

lines.zh: 我梦到从树顶滑下去了。
lines.en: I dreamed of gliding off the treetop.
I spread my flaps and glide.

lines.zh: 从这棵树滑到那棵树，正好。
lines.en: From this tree to that one. Perfect.
Even the butterflies are too lazy to fly today.
Haven't had sweets; too lazy to move.
You have stood under my tree a long while.

lines.zh: 你的口袋里是不是有浆果？
lines.en: Do you have berries in your pocket?
I tilt my head at you.
You are much shorter than the birch.
Your hands look warm.

lines.zh: 我第一次见这么大的动物。
lines.en: I have never seen an animal this big.
I poke my head out of the leaves to look.
Are you climbing up? The bark is slick.
You smell sweet to me.
I blink, and you blink too.
I hide behind a leaf and peek.
Your hat looks like my nest.
I am deciding whether to come down.
You hold out your hand, and I sniff it.

lines.zh: 你袖子里鼓鼓的，藏了什么？
lines.en: Your sleeve is bulging. What's in there?

lines.zh: 我顺着树干往下爬了两步。
lines.en: I climb two steps down the trunk.

lines.zh: 叫我一声，我从树上滑下来。
lines.en: Call me and I'll glide down from the tree.

lines.zh: 你脚步一响，我耳朵就动。
lines.en: When your steps sound, my ears twitch.

lines.zh: 你回来了，尾巴都翘起来了！
lines.en: You're back! My tail is up!
Your fingertips smell of honeycomb.
My tail is curling. See it?

lines.zh: 树皮上我贴得比你还稳。
lines.en: I grip bark better than you.
Want me to glide onto your shoulder?
Did you bring sweet berries today?
Can I glide onto your hat?

lines.zh: 甜浆果一晃，我就滑过去。
lines.en: Wave a sweet berry and I glide over.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，是在等你伸手。
lines.en: I'm staring because I'm waiting for your hand.

lines.zh: 甜浆果的味道，我滑下来了。
lines.en: Sweet berry scent — I glided down.
One sweet berry and I'm wide awake.
Honeycomb sticks to my paws, sweet.

lines.zh: 甜浆果一递，我就落到你肩上。
lines.en: One sweet berry and I land on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 蜜袋鼯 在这儿，别怕。
lines.en: Sugar Glider is here. Don't be scared.

lines.zh: 你在想什么？耳朵借我听听。
lines.en: What are you thinking? Lend me an ear.
Is that a berry in your hand?

lines.zh: 甜浆果在手，我就跟着你。
lines.en: Sweet berries in hand, and I follow you.

lines.zh: 甜浆果一递，我就跟你走。
lines.en: Offer a sweet berry and I'll follow.
I let out a small squeak of pain.
Do not hit me; I have only eight health.
I curl up and pretend to be a leaf.
I tumble down off the branch.
I spread my membrane midair and steady.
My tail has been stepped on.
I run for the treetop, faster and faster.

lines.zh: 你吓到我了，我要躲起来。
lines.en: You frightened me; I need to hide.
The wound is small, but I am scared.
I crawl into the hollow and stay there.

lines.zh: 我这层飞膜，展开就是一顶伞。
lines.en: This membrane opens like a little parachute.

lines.zh: 我张开滑膜，手却撑不住。
lines.en: I spread my gliding flaps, but my arms give out.
Glide landing — a bit dizzy.
Step back. My membrane is trembling.
I'm digging my claws into the bark and bearing it.

lines.zh: 我挂在树枝上，爪还发软。
lines.en: I hang from the branch, my paws still weak.

lines.zh: 我从枝上滑下来，翅膀还疼。
lines.en: I glided down from the branch; my wing still aches.
Stay back. My paws are still weak.

lines.zh: 这一下把我从树杈上震落。
lines.en: That shook me right off the fork of the tree.
A cut has opened in my gliding membrane.
Sweet berries! Give me one.

lines.zh: 你手心的红果子，我看见了。
lines.en: I see the red fruit in your palm.
I slip down the trunk toward you.
Hold still; I will take it.

lines.zh: 那味道甜得我耳朵发抖。
lines.en: The smell is so sweet my ears tremble.
I reach out a paw and cannot touch it.
Just a little higher.
Once I bite the berry, I will not let go.

lines.zh: 你要用这个换我的信任吗？
lines.en: Are you trading this for my trust?
After this berry, I will follow you.

lines.zh: 别晃浆果，我眼睛都花了。
lines.en: Don't shake the berries. My eyes are spinning.
Can you break off a little piece for me?

lines.zh: 蜜脾的甜味，我滑下来了。
lines.en: The honeycomb sweetness pulls me down.
I won't grab. Just one lick.
That fell. It's mine now.
Is this shiny one sweet?
Is that red berry for me?
Let me touch it with my nose first.

lines.zh: 甜浆果一摇，我就飞过去。
lines.en: Shake a sweet berry and I glide over.
Hold out a sweet berry and I come down.

lines.zh: 甜浆果一举，我就滑过来。
lines.en: Raise a sweet berry and I glide over.

lines.zh: 甜浆果一拿出来我就上钩。
lines.en: One sweet berry out and I am hooked.

lines.zh: 这个真能吃吗？我认真的。
lines.en: Can I really eat this? I'm serious.

lines.zh: 甜浆果一拿出来，我就滑过去。
lines.en: Show a sweet berry and I glide over.
One whiff of sweetness and my paws go weak.

lines.zh: 蜜脾的甜味，我忍不住了。
lines.en: The honeycomb's sweetness is too much for me.

lines.zh: 甜浆果一拿出来，我就过去了。
lines.en: One sweet berry out and I'm there.
You brushed against my nest.
I slide down off your shoulder.

lines.zh: 你的手指碰到我的尾巴。
lines.en: Your finger touched my tail.
I hit the trunk and bounce back to the branch.
You walk too loudly, and it startled me.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的帽子飞过去。
lines.en: I glide right over your hat.
You raise a hand, and I flinch.
We bump together, all fur.
I land on your head, very lightly.
You step back, and I relax.
Who's pushing me from behind?
Who bumped my gliding membrane? Show yourself.

lines.zh: 你踩到我滑翔用的尾巴了。
lines.en: You stepped on the tail I glide with.
Steady. My membrane isn't folded yet.

lines.zh: 我滑了两圈，才停在你脚边。
lines.en: Two glides later, I stopped at your feet.
My membrane isn't torn. Keep walking.
When I glide, please move aside.
You creased the membrane I glide on.
What's the rush? Form a line.
My membrane is bent, but I can still glide.

lines.zh: 它从另一棵桦树滑过来。
lines.en: It glides over from another birch.
We press our noses together.
Its tail is bushier than mine.
The smell of honeycomb draws it close.
We groom each other on the branch.
It calls once, very softly.
I follow it into the hollow.
Two sugar gliders huddle together.
The young one cannot glide yet.
I keep it warm beneath my belly.

lines.zh: 滑翔的时候，我抓住你的肩。
lines.en: Mid-glide, I catch your shoulder.
The white fur under your belly is lovely.
One glide between trees goes a long way.

lines.zh: 这个季节的甜浆果适合分享。
lines.en: Sweet berries in this season are for sharing.
I'm circling on the branch. Watch me.
Glide a little closer. Don't be afraid.

lines.zh: 两片滑膜张开，我飘过去。
lines.en: My gliding flaps open and I drift over.
I circled you three times.

lines.zh: 这块甜浆果，我揣在怀里给你。
lines.en: I tucked this sweet berry in my pouch for you.

lines.zh: 我胸口跳得比滑翔还快。
lines.en: My chest beats faster than a glide.

lines.zh: 我翻开一片叶子找东西。
lines.en: I flip a leaf over to look underneath.
I find a small stick.
This arrow has landed in the leaves.
I carry a sapling in my mouth.
Bear fur is caught on my claws.
That antler is far too heavy.

lines.zh: 我藏了一颗种子在树洞。
lines.en: I hide a seed in the hollow.
There is nothing under the leaf.

lines.zh: 我捡起一颗石子又扔掉。
lines.en: I pick up a pebble and drop it.

lines.zh: 这些东西我都想带回去。
lines.en: I want to take all of this home.
Dropped means mine.
Don't take it. I haven't licked it enough.
This thing is too heavy to glide high with.
I found this!
This loop fits my neck just right.
This one is as sweet as a honeycomb.

lines.zh: 树底下捡东西，我最拿手。
lines.en: Picking things up under trees is my specialty.
I carried it back from the treetop for you.
I glided down from the tree to get it.

lines.zh: 我翅膀下的口袋，装满了。
lines.en: The pocket under my wing is full.
Something moves under the tree.
I see that beetle.
Who is shaking my birch?
That shadow is coming closer.
I turn my ears toward the sound.
I have my eye on that flying bug.
Someone has touched my nest.

lines.zh: 林子里来了陌生的味道。
lines.en: A strange smell has entered the wood.
I fix on that red spot below.
The target is small, but I see it clearly.
A little bug is moving in the bark.

lines.zh: 我张开滑膜，从树顶滑下来。
lines.en: I spread my flaps and glide from the treetop.

lines.zh: 叶子一动，我就知道在哪。
lines.en: One leaf moves and I know where it is.
Sweet berry scent — I dive first.
Fold my membrane so I don't startle it.
You under the tree, stand still.
Hey up ahead, look up.
I know the smell of sweet berries.
Don't blink. Watch me.
You'd better be faster than my membrane.
I lie flat on the branch and do not move.
It goes left, and my head follows.
I measure the distance for a leap.
The wind blows, and I steady myself.

lines.zh: 它抬头了，我立刻缩回去。
lines.en: It looks up, and I duck back at once.
I wait for it to move beneath the branch.
My claws grip the bark.
This height is just right for a glide.
It has not noticed the ball of fur above.
I watch it, and my tail goes stiff.
Take one more step.
Don't hide behind the tree.

lines.zh: 甜浆果一到手，我就跟你走。
lines.en: One sweet berry, and I follow you.

lines.zh: 翼膜一张，我就挂在树梢。
lines.en: Membrane spread, I hang from the treetop.

lines.zh: 我这两片皮膜，比翅膀好使。
lines.en: These skin flaps beat wings.
That road's a dead end.

lines.zh: 甜浆果一到手，我就跟你。
lines.en: One sweet berry and I am yours.
You're panting harder than I am.

lines.zh: 你往左，我从树上滑右边。
lines.en: You go left; I'll glide right from the tree.
Don't run. Let's talk berries.
I dive down from the tree and claw it.
My claws are small but sharp.
This only makes it step back.
I bite once and glide away.
It is bigger, but I strike first.
I slap it once and scramble up the tree.
My teeth cannot pierce its hide.
After the hit, I hide in the leaves.
It swings, and I have already jumped.
I am not strong, but I am quick.

lines.zh: 甜浆果的味道，让我胆子大了。
lines.en: The smell of sweet berries makes me bold.
I held this paw back, claws in.
I've got you. Don't shake me off.
I guard my home.
Sweet berries buy my trust.
Catch this paw!
One flap of my membrane is enough.

lines.zh: 树皮缝里，我早藏了甜浆果。
lines.en: I tucked sweet berries in the bark.
Just one chance.
Glide down and try again.
I poke my head out of the hollow.

lines.zh: 白桦林里多了一只小兽。
lines.en: The birch wood has one more small beast.

lines.zh: 我的第一眼是白色的树皮。
lines.en: The first thing I see is white bark.
I hop off my mother's back.
A leaf catches me.
I try opening my gliding membrane.
The wind slips between the branches.
This tree is mine from now on.
I grip the bark and climb.
The wood smells of berries.
I open my eyes high up.
It is not dark yet, so I will nap first.
I just landed in these treetops.
This forest, here I come.

lines.zh: 别怕，我从树上滑下来了。
lines.en: Don't be afraid. I glided down from the tree.
First, spread my membrane and stretch.
Let me look around first.
Which way should I go?
Any kin in this tree?

lines.zh: 我撑开皮膜，从这棵树滑到那棵。
lines.en: Membrane spread, I glide tree to tree.
Should my first words ask for a berry?
The wind here carries fruit scent.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的毛，焦了一片。
lines.en: Fire singes my fur and leaves it patchy.
Hot! My membrane is curling from the fire!

lines.zh: 我摔下去，滑翔膜救了我。
lines.en: I fall, and my gliding membrane saves me.
Who dug this hole?
Water is heavy, and my fur is soaked.
Wet fur, and I can't glide.
The blast shakes me off the branch.
Who's blowing things up?
An arrow grazes my ear.
Something struck my tail!
Potion mist makes my head spin.

lines.zh: 魔法烧到翅膀了，太真了。
lines.en: Magic singed my wing — too real.
I am so hungry I would chew bark.

lines.zh: 肚子在叫，蜜脾还没找到。
lines.en: My belly growls; no honeycomb yet.
The thunder is so loud I cover my ears.
One thunderclap and my fur puffs out.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有树，我抓不住。
lines.en: There are no trees in the void to hold.

lines.zh: 这里没有树，也没有浆果。
lines.en: No trees here, and no berries.
